title: BlueprintExecutiveSummary
description: ADVISORY orientation for readers of a Derived Blueprint. Not a governed artifact, never ratified, never a source of truth — a reading guide. It describes; it must not resolve, harmonize, or evaluate policy merits. Every highlight and tension carries refs into the blueprint (item_ids and/or defect codes) so a skeptical reader can check the claim against the tables.

headline.description: One or two sentences: what this regime is, at forest level

how_to_read.description: Orientation to the document's structure: families, element tables, verification marks, the defect appendix

regime_shape.description: Short narrative paragraphs describing the as-built architecture: who is regulated, by whom, through what instrument layers, with what center of gravity

highlights.description: Where a reader's attention pays off — dense nodes, load-bearing definitions, obligations everything else hangs from

tensions.description: The as-built frictions the Defect Register documents, stated AS tensions — never with a proposed resolution (that is Phase 3's job, under governance)

caveats.description: What this summary is not: evidentiary ceilings honored, ∅ items explained, manual-posture disclosures
